# ROGLE research group (UPV): members, projects and publications

Source: https://rogle.webs.upv.es. Summary: https://rogle.webs.upv.es/llms.txt. Titles keep their original language.

## Members

- Carlos Andrés Romano. University Full Professor. ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4453-4891. Topics: Cellular Manufacturing, Work Study, Production Scheduling and Sequencing, Combinatorial Optimization. https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members/andres-carlos.html
- Lourdes Canós Darós. Full Professor. ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9609-2880. https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members/canos-lourdes.html
- Rosa Esteban Amaro. Professor and Researcher. ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7895-403X. Topics: Operations Management, Artificial Intelligence and digital transformation, circular economy, sustainable operations, eco-innovation. https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members/esteban-rosa.html
- Sofia García Manglano. Member. ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0478-6218. https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members/garcia-sofia.html
- José P. Garcia-Sabater. Full Professor of Operations Management. ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9097-2852. Topics: supply chain management, operations management, management science. https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members/garcia-sabater-jose-p.html
- Julio J. García-Sabater. Associate professor. ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0001-9449-1709. Topics: process improvement and lean production; adapting operations management tools in work environments with people with intellectual disabilities. https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members/garcia-sabater-julio-j.html
- Arnau Igualde Saez. PhD student and substitute lecturer. ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0009-0824-6957. Topics: university resource planning, machine learning, academic trajectories, student dropout prediction. https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members/igualde-arnau.html
- Alberto Lacort. PhD student. ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7571-0494. Topics: hospital bed management, patient flow simulation, surgical blocks. https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members/lacort-alberto.html
- Julien Maheut. Associate Professor. ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5796-9053. Topics: workforce planning and assignment, skill-based workforce design, stochastic optimisation, LLM and metaheuristics. https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members/maheut-julien.html
- Juan A. Marín-Garcia. Professor. ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5416-3938. Topics: Participative Management, Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing Systems, TQM, TPM, Performance Evaluation and Active Learning in Higher Education. https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members/marin-garcia-juan-a.html
- Cristobal Miralles Insa. Full Professor. ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5269-9955. Topics: design of systems and workplaces accessible for people with disabilities through the use of Industrial Engineering tools. https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members/miralles-cristobal.html
- Aida Saéz Más. Member. https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members/saez-aida.html
- Pilar I. Vidal-Carreras. Associate professor of operations management. ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5206-3730. Topics: Operations Management and Lean Manufacturing. https://rogle.webs.upv.es/en/members/vidal-carreras-pilar-i.html
